name: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited

facts.business: K.C.P Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar and related products, with subsidiaries in engineering (The Eimco-K.C.P. Limited) and agricultural research farms.
key_risks: Fluctuation in sugar selling prices and government notifications impacting net realizable value of sugar inventory
Dependence on monthly quota and minimum selling price regulations
Inventory valuation risk due to significant judgment in determining net realizable value
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during the financial year were normal business transactions in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. No material related party transactions as per Regulation 23 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Prior approval of Audit Committee was obtained for all related party transactions.
